ThinkSession.title: ThinkSession
ThinkSession.description: A live or archived Think Session event for The Thinking Architect community.

number.description: Display label such as Next Session or Session 04.

timeLabel.description: Time and timezone or recording duration label.

format.description: Session format such as Conversation + Open Member Q&A.

isNextSession.description: Marks the session currently highlighted in the Next Session block on the home page.

published.description: Controls whether the session is visible to public visitors.

topics.description: Up to 6 short discussion topics (each <= 160 characters).

registrationUrl.description: Optional external registration or Tally URL.

startAtIso.description: Optional ISO-8601 start timestamp used for calendar invites and local timezone conversion.

resources.description: Up to 4 curated companion resource links ({ label, url }) attached to the session.

createdBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin who created this session.

MediaFeature.title: MediaFeature
MediaFeature.description: A published or draft recording or edited editorial feature from a Think Session.

kind.description: Whether the item is a video/audio recording or written feature.

sessionRef.description: Reference label to the source Think Session.

mediaUrl.description: Optional external HTTPS link to watch or read the recording/feature.

published.description: Controls whether the media item is visible to public visitors.

summary.description: Concise summary of the recording or feature.

createdBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin who created this media item.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Verified administrator authorized to manage sessions, media, subscribers, site settings, and fellow admins.

email.description: Verified email address of the admin.

addedBy.description: UID of the admin who granted access.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

Subscriber.title: Subscriber
Subscriber.description: Community newsletter or intake submission captured from the footer or join modal.

name.description: Optional full name provided via intake modal.

question.description: Optional question submitted by the member.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the subscription was created.

SiteSettings.title: SiteSettings
SiteSettings.description: Publicly readable community social and external channel links controlled by verified admins.

updatedBy.description: UID of the admin who last updated settings.

WrappedConfig.title: WrappedConfig
WrappedConfig.description: Admin-managed configuration, visibility toggles, Home countdown settings, and editable slide copy/metrics for TTA Year Wrapped.

enabled.description: Master toggle turning the /wrapped page live or offline.

showInFooter.description: Controls whether the Wrapped link is shown in the site footer.

showInNav.description: Controls whether the Wrapped spotlight link is shown in the top navigation bar.

homeBannerEnabled.description: Shows or hides the Wrapped teaser banner on the Home page.

homeCountdownEnabled.description: Shows or hides the live countdown timer on the Home banner and offline holding screen.

offlineTitle.description: Headline displayed when Wrapped is turned off.

offlineMessage.description: Holding message displayed when Wrapped is turned off.

homeBannerCtaLabel.description: CTA button label on Home Wrapped banner.

launchDateIso.description: Optional ISO-8601 target timestamp for the Wrapped countdown.

sessionHighlights.description: Up to 8 session highlights formatted 'Date | Title'.

extraLocations.description: Up to 10 additional cities or chapters.

customStats.description: Up to 6 additional milestone cards formatted 'Value | Label | Detail'.

TopicPitch.title: TopicPitch
TopicPitch.description: Community speaker offer or session topic suggestion submitted from /contact or /sessions for admin review.

pitchType.description: Whether the submitter is offering to speak or suggesting a topic.

email.description: Contact email address of the submitter.

roleOrStudio.description: Optional role, studio, school, or affiliation.

topicTitle.description: Proposed Think Session title or topic headline.

targetStage.description: Primary architectural career stage this conversation serves.

outline.description: Short pitch describing what would be covered and why it helps.

linkUrl.description: Optional HTTPS portfolio, LinkedIn, or talk link.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the pitch was submitted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the pitch status was last updated.

CommunityStats.title: CommunityStats
CommunityStats.description: Publicly readable aggregate community member numbers synced by admins from the Google Sheets member directory.

showOnCommunity.description: Controls whether the live community numbers band renders on /community.

studentsCount.description: Members currently in architecture school or internship.

countriesCount.description: Number of distinct countries or regions represented.

topLocations.description: Up to 10 top countries or cities represented in the community (each <= 60 chars).

sourceLabel.description: Short attribution label displayed subtly on the community stats band.

lastSyncedIso.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp when aggregate counts were last synced from Google Sheets.

updatedBy.description: UID of the admin who updated community stats.

GoogleSheetsConfig.title: GoogleSheetsConfig
GoogleSheetsConfig.description: Strictly admin-only metadata pointing to the linked Google Sheets member spreadsheet and detected columns.

spreadsheetId.description: Google Sheets spreadsheet ID (confidential to verified admins).

spreadsheetTitle.description: Display title returned by Google Sheets API.

sheetName.description: Selected sheet tab name inside the spreadsheet.

emailColumn.description: Header name used for optional member deduplication.

stageColumn.description: Header name used to compute student, graduate, and practitioner counts.

locationColumn.description: Header name used to compute countries and top locations.

lastSyncedIso.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp of last successful sync.

updatedBy.description: UID of the admin who saved the sheet connection.

LiveSessionState.title: LiveSessionState
LiveSessionState.description: Publicly readable live broadcast state stored at /liveState/current controlling the Home live room banner, elapsed timer, and live Q&A queue.

isLive.description: Turns Live Session Companion Mode ON or OFF across the Home spotlight banner, navbar, and active session room.

sessionId.description: ID of the active Think Session being hosted live.

sessionNumber.description: Session display label such as Session 04.

sessionTitle.description: Headline of the active live session.

speaker.description: Speaker or panel name for the live session.

startedAtIso.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when Live Mode started for elapsed session timer display.

roomUrl.description: Optional external Google Meet / Zoom / stream join URL.

qaOpen.description: Controls whether attendees can submit and upvote Q&A questions on the active session page.

updatedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin who updated live state.

SessionQuestion.title: SessionQuestion
SessionQuestion.description: Real-time attendee Q&A question with community upvoting and host on-air triage.

sessionId.description: ID of the Think Session this question belongs to.

authorName.description: Public display name of the attendee (no email or PII).

authorStage.description: Optional career stage label such as Student or Practising Architect.

questionText.description: Concise question submitted for the speaker and host.

upvotes.description: Positive upvote counter incremented monotonically (+1) by attendees.

status.description: Live moderation queue status controlled by verified admins.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the question was submitted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest upvote or host status change.

/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Collection of upcoming and archived Think Sessions; public visitors may read published documents, admins control all CRUD.

/media/{mediaId}.description: Collection of recordings and editorial features from Think Sessions; public visitors may read published documents, admins control all CRUD.

/admins/{userId}.description: RBAC registry of authorized administrators keyed by Firebase Auth UID; strictly private to admins.

/subscribers/{subscriberId}.description: Community email signups and intake submissions; public create-only with strict validation, read/delete strictly isolated to admins.

/pitches/{pitchId}.description: Speaker offers and topic pitches; public create-only with status forced to 'new', admin-only reads, status updates, and deletes.

/siteSettings/{settingId}.description: Public site channel links stored at /siteSettings/public; public get, admin-only writes.

/wrappedConfig/{configId}.description: Publicly readable Wrapped configuration stored at /wrappedConfig/public and yearly archives at /wrappedConfig/year-YYYY; admin-only writes.

/communityStats/{statId}.description: Publicly readable aggregate community metrics at /communityStats/public (zero PII); admin-only writes.

/adminConfig/{configId}.description: Strictly admin-only integration configuration such as /adminConfig/googleSheets holding confidential spreadsheet identifiers.

/liveState/{stateId}.description: Publicly readable singleton live broadcast state at /liveState/current; admin-only writes.

/sessionQuestions/{questionId}.description: Publicly readable live Q&A questions (zero PII) with attendee +1 upvote updates and admin-only moderation and deletion.
